name: Tor SOCKS Proxy
short_desc: Client-only Tor SOCKS5 proxy with optional bridges to bypass censorship.
author: ayushsharma82
description: A Tor SOCKS5 proxy (and optional DNS over Tor) built from the official Tor source with relay support compiled out. Supports obfs4, webtunnel, meek_lite and snowflake bridges to get around ISP or network restrictions. Point any SOCKS5-capable client at <host>:<port>.

form_fields.label: Tor bridges (optional). Separate multiple bridge lines with ';'. Leave empty to connect without bridges.
form_fields.placeholder: obfs4 192.0.2.10:443 FINGERPRINT cert=CERT iat-mode=0; webtunnel [2001:db8::1]:443 FINGERPRINT url=https://example.com/path ver=0.0.1

form_fields.label: Host port for DNS over Tor (UDP)
